messages:
jordan: Morning folks, quick onboarding blockers. I can't enable Cloud KMS in my GCP project (permission denied), the project shows no billing account, and GCP console says MySQL quota for the project is exhausted in europe-west1. Also need an AWS cross-account role so CI can push to a shared S3 bucket but the role arn isn't available in SSO. Who should I tag?

kai: welcome @jordan! paste the exact KMS error and your project number. For the AWS role, file an SSO request with the role arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/rdw-ci-s3 and include your Okta email. Ops usually wires it up after Okta group check.

jordan: KMS error when trying to enable API: 
```
ERROR: PERMISSION_DENIED: Service "cloudkms.googleapis.com" is disabled at the organization/folder level for your project.
```
Project number 678901234567. MySQL quota error when creating Cloud SQL instance: 
```
ERROR: QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Instance creation failed due to regional instance limit.
```
Billing UI says "No billing account linked" and the link button is greyed out.

ops: thanks Jordan. looks like project landed under a locked folder with org policies blocking KMS and disallowing billing linkage. I opened INFRA-13579 to: 1) move project to onboarding-sandbox, 2) attach billingAccounts/8888-7777-6666, 3) request a soft regional quota bump for Cloud SQL in europe-west1 for onboarding. I'll also add `roles/kms.admin` and `roles/billing.projectManager` to your user for the migration. ETA 60m.

billing-bot: Billing check: billingAccounts/8888-7777-6666 exists and can be linked. User jordan currently lacks billing.projectManager permission. Ticket INFRA-13579 created.

security: quick note  enabling KMS in projects that might manage keys for customer data requires a short justification. Jordan, confirm whether you'll create keys for any customer PII or only demo/test keys.

jordan: only demo/test keys for local encryption tests, no customer data. Added that to the ticket.

ops: Update: moved project 678901234567 to onboarding-sandbox and linked billing account. KMS still blocked by org-level service denial; opening an exception request flow INFRA-13579-EX to allow cloudkms for onboarding-sandbox. Also submitted quota request for Cloud SQL +2 instances in europe-west1 for 24h onboarding window.

kai: for AWS SSO, once ops adds you to `infra-dev` Okta group your SSO request for arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/rdw-ci-s3 should auto-approve. Please submit REQ id here when you do it.

jordan: filed SSO request REQ-90012 and attached to INFRA-13579. Thanks for the fast help, I'll test KMS and Cloud SQL after the exception and quota bump.

ops: INFRA-13579 update: billing linked, project moved, Okta group add scheduled, KMS exception request sent to security, quota bump requested. Will post updates here when KMS exception approved or quota applied.

jordan: verified I can now link billing and Cloud SQL creation worked after quota bump. KMS still pending exception. Will wait for security sign-off. Thanks all!
